purpose: Haishool trained on ONLY the simulated worlds of round 7 (lessons and stories of haishool/evo and the corrected round-6 levels of haishool/cosmos under rules 7): no old facts, no hops, no truth topics.
gpu: GPU 0 (RTX 4090) only, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0; GPU 1 and the services on ports 8650-8652 untouched
launcher: /home/ender/haishool-sim7/run-sim7.sh (only on adler; exports CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8)
resume: Run 'bash run-sim7.sh' again (in the same tmux session name): every phase resumes (training from runs/sim7/train/latest.pt, saved every 1000 steps). The training fingerprint includes the sha256 of every haishool/*.py file in the workspace, so do not edit code there before a resume. runs/sim7/settings.json locks the settings; runs/sim7/run.lock prevents a second launch.

code.trainer: haishool/train_final.py with --mix sim (train(mix='sim')); mix 'final' is the default and unchanged

timeline_utc.run_expected_complete: about 2026-10-02T11:20Z to 11:30Z (dev, sealed, train recall, summary, fp16 export after training)

model.precision: bf16 autocast, float32 weights; export float16

steps_reason: Measured on adler GPU 0 at exactly this configuration: 34.65 steps/s in a 2000-step benchmark on the smoke dataset (steps 100-2000, including a checkpoint), 33.08 steps/s on the real dataset (steps 100-3100). The default 60000 steps would train in about 29 minutes; 105000 steps give about 51 min at the benchmark rate and 53 min at the measured real rate, inside the requested 45-60 minutes with margin on both sides.

token_mix.rule: lessons (predict_*) 0.8 and stories (legacy_*) 0.2 of the sampled tokens, each split equally among the 12 topics of its group

predict_signals.status: saturated (finite input space; same token share as the other lesson topics, so more repetitions)

dataset.repetition_note: 1.29 billion sampled tokens over 25.3 million: each lesson topic is seen about 95-250 times (predict_signals most), each story topic about 10-27 times.

evaluation.policy: dev and sealed are each evaluated once with a fingerprinted marker (final_run's rule): a started evaluation is never redone with another checkpoint. No selection between checkpoints: the final student.pt is evaluated.
evaluation.gates: lessons by their LessonGate (curriculum7.lesson_gates); stories by the level's simulation().check (haishool.evo.<level>; legacy_<old>_rules7 by haishool.cosmos.<old>.simulation(), which replays rules 7 prompts). All 12288 dev and sealed golds were accepted by these gates before training (runs/sim7/gates.json).
evaluation.scoring: final_run.score_lines / ask_many (greedy, equal-length batches); per-topic reports in final_run's format plus all_lines, seeded/seedless and language counts
evaluation.unscorable_lines: A dev or sealed prompt with a word outside the vocabulary (a world7 era such as replicators_2 that only a held-out world reaches) cannot be asked: such lines are listed under 'unscorable' and counted as wrong in all_lines and in summary.json.
evaluation.caveat: Dev and sealed story questions name seeds the model never saw (seeds are split train/dev/sealed for all levels at once), so they measure guessing, not memory; memorisation of stories is measured on the train split (train-recall.json: 256 sampled lines per story topic judged by the exact trained answer, and every world7 say/meaning line of the train worlds judged by the world7 gate). Lessons are computable from the question: their dev/sealed scores measure whether the rules were learned.

results.phase: runs/sim7/status.json ('complete' when done; 'failed' with the error otherwise)
results.summary: runs/sim7/summary.json: dev / sealed / train_recall, each with lessons and stories (macro and micro gate_ok, per topic), stories by seeded vs seedless lines, world7_language {say, meaning: n asked, right}
results.export: runs/sim7/export/sim7-8x512-fp16.pt (keys model_state in float16, gpt_config, itos; loads with haishool.student.load) and sim7-8x512-fp16.json (sha256, max error vs float32, probe answers)
